rule: GOAL: Guide the purple orb along the diagonal path to land precisely on the gray target square. CONTROLS: Click any path cell within six steps to instantly move the orb’s center to that spot. RULE: The orb moves exactly six diagonal steps per click, landing only on valid path cells. TRAP: Assuming you can click the final target directly; it may be blocked or require landing on an adjacent path dot first.

GOAL: Align the colored dots precisely onto their matching cross centers. CONTROLS: Click the colored panel to extend the bar, moving the dot one step per click. RULE: The bar grows three pixels per click, so you must calculate exact multiples to hit the center. TRAP: Believing the bar stops at the cross edge; it actually passes through, requiring overshoot to center the dot.

GOAL: Move the block to the marked goal using the fewest steps. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one square in that direction. RULE: You cannot pass through walls or other solid obstacles. TRAP: Assuming diagonal movement is allowed wastes time when only cardinal directions work.

GOAL: Clear the level in two moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the paddle. Space launches the ball. RULE: The ball leaves a magenta trail where it travels. TRAP: Mistaking the trail for a wall or solid obstacle instead of a path record.

GOAL: Align your yellow marker with the gap in the wall to pass through. CONTROLS: Use left and right keys to shift your position horizontally. RULE: Your movement pushes the gray floor in the opposite direction, revealing the path. TRAP: Do not try to push the wall; the wall is fixed, only the gray area moves.

GOAL: Clear the keypad to extend the tube, then push the plug fully into the left handle. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug two columns per press. RULE: The plug must navigate through the extended channel to reach the light-blue reservoir. TRAP: Assuming the plug stays 4x4; it shrinks after the keypad solve, changing its movement logic.

GOAL: Shrink the plug to fit the narrow shaft, then push it to the handle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; clicks toggle keypad tiles. RULE: Matching the yellow pattern on the keypad compresses the plug’s size. TRAP: Assuming the plug stays rigid; it must shrink to pass the two-cell wide channel.

GOAL: Align the player with the gap in the lower wall to escape. CONTROLS: Four blue buttons shift the player or walls horizontally to change alignment. RULE: The player’s position dictates the gray shape’s steps; only the lower wall’s gap matters for exit. TRAP: Assuming the top wall’s solid barrier affects the solution wastes moves; ignore it and focus solely on the lower passage.

GOAL: Merge two pieces to create the yellow target and place it in the circle. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move nearest piece; click between two pieces to merge them. RULE: Pieces merge only when both are within reach of the same click point. TRAP: Assuming merges require adjacent pieces; they can merge from a distance if the click is valid.

GOAL: Align all five slot bars to black to move the piece down into the cup. CONTROLS: Click bars to toggle black or white; press the button to execute the combined move. RULE: Black horizontal and black vertical bars together signal a downward movement of four units. TRAP: Assuming white bars are needed for stability or that mixed colors create a neutral state.

GOAL: Rotate each pink bar slot to match the rotation class of the corresponding blue bar tile above. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between slots; pressing UP rotates the selected glyph to the next shape in its cycle. RULE: A slot is solved only when its glyph shares the same rotational orientation as the blue tile directly above it. TRAP: Ignoring the top blue tiles and trying to match pink glyphs to each other wastes moves on invalid targets.

GOAL: Align the plug, fire a beam to clear the red block, and slide the plug into the handle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; the beam fires automatically along the plug's current alignment. RULE: The beam only destroys blocks matching the plug's exposed half; moving the plug swaps which half faces forward. TRAP: Assuming the beam passes through obstacles; it stops at the first matching block, requiring precise alignment to clear the path.

GOAL: Merge scattered blocks to form specific shapes and deliver them to target circles. CONTROLS: Click a cell to pull the nearest block center toward that point, causing collisions to merge blocks. RULE: Blocks move in straight lines until hitting another block or the grid edge, stacking to grow size. TRAP: Assuming clicks move a specific block; they actually grab the closest one, so stray blocks can hijack your intended move.

GOAL: Reach the exit tile in three moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move you two tiles in that direction. RULE: You cannot stop on or pass through the enemy. TRAP: Believing you can defeat the enemy by moving into it from below.

ESTABLISHED: The player can attach and detach boxes using SPACE while facing them. Boxes move in the opposite direction of the player's movement. FAILED: Attempting to move through a box without attaching first. Attempting to push a box when not adjacent. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching a specific coordinate. The goal involves arranging boxes to cover a target area or bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player or push attached boxes. SPACE attaches a box in front or detaches the carried box.

GOAL: Shift water leftward to fill the left tanks and empty the right ones. CONTROLS: Left buttons pump water from the right neighbor to the left; right buttons do the reverse. RULE: Only left-side buttons move water toward the goal; right buttons undo progress. TRAP: Assuming right buttons fill left tanks wastes moves; they actually drain the left side.

GOAL: Move the crate below the player to the right by pushing it. CONTROLS: Arrows move or rotate the character; Space attaches or detaches from a crate. RULE: You can only push a crate if you are attached to it and the space ahead is free. TRAP: Thinking a rotation counts as movement; rotating in place wastes actions without shifting position.

ESTABLISHED: The head moves vertically; items shift only within the arm's current aligned band. FAILED: Pushing items into the top band from below, as the arm cannot reach it. GOAL IS NOT: Placing items in the top band, as the mechanism physically prevents this. CONTROLS: Up and down move the head and push aligned items. Right and left extend the arm and shift items horizontally.

GOAL: Align horizontal bars to redirect liquid streams into three separate collection cups. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift bars horizontally or vertically; spacebar confirms the arrangement. RULE: Bars only redirect liquid if they physically block the upward flow path, splitting streams at their edges. TRAP: Assuming bars can move freely in any direction; vertical movement is restricted near the cup zone, requiring careful horizontal positioning instead.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit while eliminating three facing enemies. CONTROLS: Arrows move two cells, jumping over the midpoint. RULE: Jumping onto an enemy destroys it; enemies only lunge at distance two. TRAP: Believing you can walk normally through enemies or ignore the midpoint cell when jumping.

GOAL: Match the target color sequence shown at the top by filling the four empty slots below in the exact same order. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom palette to select it, then click an empty slot to place the selected color into that position. RULE: The arrangement of colors in the top reference row dictates the required left-to-right order for the slots. TRAP: Assuming any valid arrangement works or misreading the top row as a random palette instead of the strict solution order.

GOAL: Rotate six independent glyph slots to match target patterns using a moving bracket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selection bracket; Up rotates the current slot. RULE: Each slot has its own unique rotation cycle; some patterns are unreachable from others. TRAP: Assuming all slots share one cycle wastes time; you must scan each slot’s specific loop to find valid matches.

GOAL: Guide two crosses to cover all matching dots on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches which cross you control. RULE: Each cross must cover dots of its own color; the other color’s dots are ignored by it. TRAP: Assuming you must move both crosses simultaneously or that mixed colors block movement; they do not.

GOAL: Guide falling liquid into three empty cups by positioning moving bars underneath. CONTROLS: Click a bar to select it, use arrow keys to slide it horizontally, and press Space to release the liquid. RULE: A bar acts as a solid floor; liquid stops and fills the cup only when it hits a bar directly above the cup. TRAP: Thinking you could stack multiple bars in one column to save moves, when only the topmost bar matters for the current fill.

GOAL: Move the orange X to cover three specific gray boxes by cycling through shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the active shape; Space switched between blue plus, orange X, and red diamond. RULE: Only the active shape moves, but all shapes pass through gray boxes to clear them. TRAP: Assuming the white cursor always shows the active center; overlapping shapes hid it, so track shape centers directly.

GOAL: Clear the board by moving all pegs off the grid. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a highlighted spot to jump. RULE: You can only jump over an adjacent peg into an empty space directly beyond it. TRAP: Assuming you can jump into a space occupied by another peg, which wastes moves and stalls progress.

GOAL: Align the yellow tile with the bracket marker. CONTROLS: Red arrow rotates the ring counter-clockwise; green rotates clockwise. RULE: The level completes instantly when the unique yellow tile sits in the highlighted slot. TRAP: Assuming complex color patterns needed matching; only the single yellow tile’s position mattered.

GOAL: Move the handle directly onto the anchor point. CONTROLS: Click anywhere to instantly teleport the handle to that location. RULE: Success occurs only when the handle and anchor perfectly overlap. TRAP: Focusing on the decorative rope or midpoint block wastes time; ignore them.

ESTABLISHED: The yellow block moves up until its body hits the purple tail at row 26. FAILED: Attempting to push the yellow past row 26 results in a block, confirming the tail is immovable. GOAL IS NOT: Moving the yellow block through the purple tail structure. CONTROLS: Extending the sky block pushes the yellow and green blocks upward by one row per extension.

GOAL: Align the bottom glyph with the top one. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the block across the grid. RULE: Covering the cross marker flips the glyph to match. TRAP: Thinking the block needed to enter the top panel to finish.

GOAL: Guide two separate agents to meet at the single intersection point in the top corridor. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both agents simultaneously in the same direction relative to their own grids. RULE: Walls in one grid block only that agent, allowing independent movement despite shared inputs. TRAP: Assuming the agents mirror each other’s position or move symmetrically across the entire map.

GOAL: Match the outer grid colors to the center key pattern. CONTROLS: Click outer cells to toggle between blue and red. RULE: The center mini-grid dictates the correct color for each corresponding outer cell. TRAP: Assuming the outer grid was correct and trying to change the center key instead.

GOAL: Match the mini-grid patterns to the main grid to reveal the hidden image. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color and align with the reference pattern. RULE: Each mini-grid corresponds to a specific section of the main board, dictating the correct color for those cells. TRAP: Assuming the mini-grids were decorative or that clicking outside the target zones had no penalty wasted moves.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover every dot at once. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles to the next one. RULE: Completion triggers only when all dots are hidden simultaneously. TRAP: Thinking shapes must stay put; moving them uncovers dots until the final placement.

GOAL: Place all colored boxes into their matching target slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click two boxes to swap their positions; press Space to verify the current arrangement. RULE: A green highlight confirms a box is in its correct slot, while a ring indicates the first mismatched position. TRAP: Assuming adjacent colors belong together wastes time; trust the ring’s index to identify exactly which slot is wrong.

GOAL: Move two yellow tiles onto two yellow brackets. CONTROLS: Clicks rotated a perimeter ring or shifted horizontal conveyor belts. RULE: Tiles moved with their current belt or ring; overlapping cells belonged to both. TRAP: Assuming yellows could cross belts freely; they only moved when their active belt was clicked.

GOAL: Guide two separate characters to meet at a single safe spot near the bottom center. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved only the currently active character one step at a time. RULE: Both characters had to occupy the exact same open cell to finish the level. TRAP: Assuming you could move both characters simultaneously or that reaching the general bottom area was enough.

GOAL: Paint the grid's orange cells using overlapping pattern panels. CONTROLS: Click cells to apply the panel's color pattern centered on that cell. RULE: Overlapping panels combine colors; orange overrides red, making the union visible. TRAP: Assuming panels tile without overlap or that red is a target color to paint.

GOAL: Place colored tokens into specific slots to match the target sequence, filling open slots and ring-marked spots in order. CONTROLS: Click a palette color, then click a slot to place it. Press space to submit your solution. RULE: Ring colors link specific slots to box interiors; tokens must fill the combined path left-to-right. TRAP: Assuming rings were decorative. Ignoring their color-linking rule led to misplaced tokens and failed submissions.

GOAL: Paint the grid so every cell respects the color constraints set by the overlapping mini-puzzles. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color: blue to red, red to orange, orange back to blue. RULE: A cell marked as generic must differ from the mini’s specific color, not necessarily match a target hue. TRAP: Assuming ambiguous cells had only one valid color; choosing the nearest color to blue saves clicks over forcing a specific match.

ESTABLISHED: Every input, including clicks on empty space, consumes one step from the limited budget. FAILED: Clicking the right block’s box and moving it up then right did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving blocks onto rings or matching dot colors, as these actions failed. CONTROLS: Clicking selects a block; arrow keys move it one cell; every input costs one step.

GOAL: Guide blocks to cover their matching rings within a strict action limit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected block; clicks select it. Every action, even wasted ones, drains the timer. RULE: Only the currently active block moves. Clicking a block activates it for arrow commands. TRAP: Assuming clicks are free. They consume timer units, so plan precise paths to avoid wasting time on selection.

ESTABLISHED: The red block ignores walls and slides along its row. Its body is a single-cell trail that follows the head. The gray block is a shorter version of this snake mechanic. FAILED: Moving the player does not force the red block to move step-for-step in the same direction. The red block’s movement is not directly tied to every player action. GOAL IS NOT: Simply guiding the red block to a specific coordinate using direct pushes. The puzzle is not a standard sliding block problem where input equals output position. CONTROLS: Player movement moves the player. The red block moves independe

GOAL: Activate three nodes and route their blocks to seal a ring. CONTROLS: Click a node to activate it; click a destination to move its block. RULE: A block seals the ring only if it covers the required ring pixels. TRAP: Assuming a block can pass through walls; its footprint must remain clear along the entire path.

GOAL: Place both the yellow and orange tiles onto their matching colored brackets to finish the puzzle. CONTROLS: The left green button rotates the board counter-clockwise; the right green button rotates it clockwise. RULE: Tiles slide across the grid during rotation, so you must maneuver them into position before the spin completes. TRAP: Thinking the bracket colors were decorative or that only one tile mattered; both must be placed correctly.

GOAL: Slide the moving shape to perfectly cover the stationary yellow outline. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the shape; each step shifted it three cells. RULE: Movement was strictly step-based, requiring exact counts to align edges without overshooting. TRAP: Assuming smooth sliding wasted time; ignoring the three-cell jump led to frequent misalignment.

GOAL: Turn specific cells purple to satisfy pattern constraints, including toggle cells. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle their color; some cells flip a cross-shaped neighborhood. RULE: Toggle cells are not just switches; they must also match the required color pattern themselves. TRAP: Assuming toggle cells are exempt from the main color rules, leading to skipped constraints and failed solves.

GOAL: Clear the first level in six moves. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the player. Space reset the run and recorded a ghost. RULE: A ghost replaying your moves triggers a mechanism to move a blocking object. TRAP: Thinking you could move the blocker yourself. Standing on the trigger only causes a temporary shift that reverses immediately upon leaving.

GOAL: Move the plug down and right to connect its tips to the pins. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the entire plug one cell in the pressed direction. RULE: The plug moves as a single rigid body; all parts shift together. TRAP: Thinking you can steer individual parts or rotate the shape independently.

GOAL: Slide the gray boundary until its top edge aligns with the yellow marker on the black bar. CONTROLS: Click the top blue button to move the yellow handle right; click the bottom blue button to move it left. RULE: The top and bottom edges of the gray area move in opposite directions, keeping their total width constant. TRAP: Assuming clicking the top button would move the boundary toward the marker; it actually moved it away.

ESTABLISHED: Arrow keys move a knob inside a small box. Clicking hats moves a lever. The knob never changes the board state. FAILED: Moving the knob to different positions before clicking hats did nothing. Toggling hat states had no effect on the goal. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the knob adjacent to the checker piece. Aligning the knob with specific grid cells. CONTROLS: Arrows move the knob. Clicking a hat rotates or shifts the lever.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to reach the green tile. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move you two steps in that direction. RULE: You can only jump if the tile you pass over is gray. TRAP: Believing the maze layout changes; it is static, so the path is fixed.

GOAL: Align the sliding handle with the target marker on the track. CONTROLS: Clicking the lower left button drains the top bar to fill the middle one. Clicking the lower right button drains the middle bar to push the handle right. RULE: You cannot push the handle if the middle bar is empty, so you must transfer volume from the top bar first. TRAP: Thinking you could just click the handle button repeatedly; it stops working once the middle bar runs dry.

GOAL: Align the moving shape with the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the active piece; Space swaps which piece you control. RULE: Mirroring only works if the fixed axis stays centered between both pieces. TRAP: Trying to drag the static piece instead of the active one wastes moves.

GOAL: Place the blue block into the right-hand slot. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character; Space absorbs or releases the block. RULE: Carrying a block locks your facing direction, keeping the block fixed relative to you. TRAP: Believing you must turn to push the block sideways; instead, move horizontally while facing up.

GOAL: Drop the tile into the cup-shaped bracket at the bottom. CONTROLS: Toggle buttons to set movement directions, then click the ball to execute the path. RULE: The tile’s bottom notch must align with the bracket’s central bump to fit. TRAP: Assuming any bottom position works; the tile must land precisely to interlock with the bracket.

GOAL: Reach the green tile without being crushed by the charging enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player; the enemy charged when triggered. RULE: The enemy charges only if the player occupies its target row or column. TRAP: Assuming you could stand in the enemy's path; it crushes anything in its charge lane.

GOAL: Match the top pattern to fill the bottom row. CONTROLS: Left and right move the cursor; up changes the symbol. RULE: Each symbol transforms into the one shown above it in the key. TRAP: Pressing up on a correct symbol breaks it; only adjust mismatched slots.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking above aligns the player to break ceiling blocks in the passage. Room D is a dead end with no ceiling blocks. The level remains unsolved. FAILED: Clicking below the player in the same room did not cause descent. Clicking into a lower room (Room B) was untested but hypothesized to enable movement. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the top room or breaking all visible blocks, as Room D is blocked and the level did not complete upon arrival. CONTROLS: Mouse clicks attempt upward movement or block breaking when aligned with a ceiling block in the current passage.

ESTABLISHED: DOWN rotates the assembly down and sideways, creating distinct left and right vertical poses from the L and R poses. UP reverses this rotation. FAILED: LEFT and RIGHT from the home pose do not move the assembly down; they only shift it sideways. UP and DOWN from home are no-ops. GOAL IS NOT: A simple horizontal or vertical translation of the assembly; the solution requires rotational movement to access lower regions. CONTROLS: LEFT/RIGHT rotate the assembly horizontally. DOWN rotates it downward into a vertical stance. UP returns it to the horizontal stance.

GOAL: Balance five liquid columns to target heights by shifting volume between adjacent tanks. CONTROLS: Click arrows between tanks to push two units of fluid from one side to the other. RULE: Every transfer requires at least two units in the source tank and keeps destination tanks below their overflow caps. TRAP: Assuming you can fill the middle tanks first; you must drain them early to create space for incoming flow.

GOAL: Slide two black shapes onto yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape. Space switches which shape is active. RULE: Moving a shape mirrors its copy across the center line. TRAP: Assuming the axis is the only mover. Space cycles control between shapes, not just the axis.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to clear the level while avoiding lethal zones projected by enemy tiles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player exactly two tiles in the chosen direction, skipping the intermediate square. RULE: Enemies instantly kill you if you land on the tile exactly two spaces ahead of their facing direction. TRAP: Assuming you can safely cross the empty space directly in front of an enemy, rather than the specific target tile.

GOAL: Paint the left band purple, then the top half white to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the stamp position; Space applies ink; Mouse selects colors. RULE: Each stamp covers a specific vertical slice, so position the stamp exactly to align bands. TRAP: Assuming one stamp covers the whole area wastes time; precise placement is required for separate sections.

GOAL: Slide the purple square along the dotted path to reach the blue circle. CONTROLS: Click the next dot on the trail to move the square two steps up and right. RULE: The square always swaps places with the clicked dot, leaving the previous position empty. TRAP: Clicking a dot that is not the immediate next step on the path wastes a move.

GOAL: Align a U-piece and a bar-piece onto their target spots while positioning the symmetry axis correctly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected piece or axis; the spacebar cycles which element is active. RULE: The axis mirrors your moves, so align pieces first and shift the axis last to avoid confusion. TRAP: Thinking the mirrored copies are solid obstacles; they are visual only and do not block movement.

GOAL: Match the pink row's shape counts to the yellow row's scrambled glyphs. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selection and cycled values; the count was the key. RULE: The sum of individual glyph counts (1+3+2+1) had to equal the total length. TRAP: Assuming left-to-right order mattered, ignoring that the yellow row was intentionally scrambled.

GOAL: Break three blocks to open a ceiling passage, then rise and slide left to touch the hanging flower. CONTROLS: Click blocks to destroy them; press arrows to move horizontally along the ceiling. RULE: Only open ceiling gaps allow vertical ascent; horizontal movement at the ceiling aligns you with the target. TRAP: Thinking the flower is reachable from the floor; you must first break through the roof to access the upper room.

GOAL: Transform the starting glyph sequence to match the required target string. CONTROLS: Arrows cycle the selected slot through available glyph options. RULE: Each slot operates independently; changing one does not affect others. TRAP: Assuming glyphs are limited to those in the target string; decoy options exist and must be cycled past.

GOAL: Transform the top row's source color into the bottom row's target color using a multi-step color chain. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the cursor; pressing Enter confirmed moves or applied color transformations to the selected tiles. RULE: You must follow the specific color conversion path defined by the pair rules, applying each step sequentially. TRAP: Assuming a direct color swap works; failing to recognize the required intermediate color step caused wasted moves.

GOAL: Fill the middle slots to match the top color sequence. CONTROLS: Click a bottom color to select it, then click a middle slot to place it. RULE: Each placement consumes the selected color, turning its source spot into a gray dot. TRAP: Believing you could drag colors directly; you must select first, then click the target slot.

GOAL: Guide the downward beam through the gap between the cups to hit the target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the horizontal bar; Space fires the beam. RULE: The beam’s width and center position strictly follow the bar’s placement. TRAP: Trying to shrink the beam by narrowing the bar, ignoring that the beam’s minimum width exceeds the cup’s opening.

GOAL: Match the pattern card on the keypad using the plug tip. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug tip; selecting cells marks them green. RULE: Correctly filling the required grid cells validates the key and opens the door. TRAP: Do not assume the green bar is a timer; it is a step counter that drains with every action.

GOAL: Arrange colored pieces in a specific depth-first order. CONTROLS: Click pieces to select, click slots to place, press space to submit. RULE: Red pieces occupy the first and last slots, with green pieces filling the middle. TRAP: Assuming red pieces cluster together rather than bracketing the green sequence causes submission errors.

GOAL: Pass the large tip through a narrow neck to reach the head. CONTROLS: Click white pattern cells to shrink the tip; press arrows to move it. RULE: Clicking all marked white cells shrinks the piece, allowing it to fit through the two-wide passage. TRAP: Assuming the piece stays full size; ignoring the white markers leaves the tip too wide for the gap.

GOAL: Fill hidden sub-boxes using flattened tree order. CONTROLS: Click palette, click slot, press Space. RULE: Expand branches in depth-first sequence, preserving column alignment. TRAP: Assuming fixed slot indices ignores tree structure and column alignment.

GOAL: Park the knob inside the sparkle's center. CONTROLS: Click side glyphs to extend or shrink the colored bar by three units. RULE: The knob sits at the bar's tip, moving exactly three spaces per click. TRAP: Assuming the bar grows to fill the space; it moves the knob, not the whole bar.

GOAL: Fit the green sub-box into the red sequence so the pre-filled letter matches the hidden key. CONTROLS: Click palette letters to place them in slots; click the empty green frame to attach the sub-box; press Space to submit. RULE: The pre-filled letter in the sub-box locks its position, revealing where the whole box connects. TRAP: Assuming the sub-box connects where its first slot aligns visually, ignoring the fixed letter constraint.

GOAL: Align both crosses with their matching colored tokens. CONTROLS: Arrows slide crosses; presses move them in fixed steps. RULE: A cross captures tokens only when its center aligns perfectly with the token cluster. TRAP: Thinking you must move crosses sequentially; they move independently, so plan both paths together to save actions.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens into red and blue boxes to satisfy hidden equality rules. CONTROLS: Click palette tokens, then click grid slots to place them. Press space to submit. RULE: The red box contents plus the blue box contents must exactly match the available palette. TRAP: Assuming all visible red tokens are fixed constraints; some slots were actually empty placeholders for blue tokens.

GOAL: Fill the root box to order three child groups matching the key sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette pieces to select, then click empty slots to place them. RULE: Each child box’s first color identifies its position in the root box. TRAP: Assuming hollow placeholders belong in child boxes instead of the root.

GOAL: Nest three colored boxes inside each other to match a symmetrical color sequence. CONTROLS: Drag solid tiles to fill outer edges; drag hollow tiles to create nested openings. RULE: Middle slots must hold hollow pieces to allow inner boxes to fit perfectly inside. TRAP: Assuming outer slots need hollow pieces; they must hold solid colors to frame the nested pattern.

GOAL: Position the head so the anchor becomes its midpoint relative to a target. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move head. Click anchor to swap head and anchor positions. RULE: Swapping places the head at the anchor’s spot and the anchor at the head’s previous spot. TRAP: Assuming clicking the anchor moves only the head; it actually displaces the anchor to the old head location.

ESTABLISHED: The beam extends horizontally to hit blocks, moving them. The score remains zero despite all actions. The avatar moves vertically. FAILED: Extending the beam to maximum length or sweeping it vertically through blocks. Pressing horizontal directions when the beam is clear or attached. GOAL IS NOT: Simply extending the beam, sweeping vertically, or moving the avatar to a specific row. CONTROLS: UP/DOWN moves the avatar vertically. LEFT/RIGHT extends/retracts the beam and moves attached blocks. SPACE is unresponsive.

GOAL: Align three colored X-shapes onto matching target clusters by centering each on its respective grid intersection. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape one step; Space cycles selection between shapes. RULE: Each shape must be centered exactly on its target color’s crosshair, with equal arm lengths. TRAP: Assuming all shapes move simultaneously; they must be selected and moved individually.

GOAL: Rotate the plug so its pattern matches the socket's lock, then insert it. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the plug; a specific button rotated its orientation. RULE: Insertion only succeeds when the plug's current pattern aligns with the socket's design. TRAP: Believing movement alone solves it; ignoring rotation wastes steps trying to force a mismatched plug.

GOAL: Slide the ring until the yellow block aligns with the bracketed slot. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the entire ring left or right. RULE: The ring is a closed loop, so moving one step wraps around the corners. TRAP: Thinking you could move blocks individually; only the whole ring rotates together.

GOAL: Move the bar to collect tokens, then route the X and diamond to their targets. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the selected piece; Space cycles between the bar, X, and diamond. RULE: The bar spans three cells, so position its center to cover distant tokens simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming the center coordinate matches the visual center exactly can cause off-by-one alignment errors.

GOAL: Move two blocks to specific target positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously. RULE: Blocks stop if they hit a wall or another block. TRAP: Assuming blocks pass through each other; they block movement instead.

GOAL: Match your shapes to the colored tokens by touching the matching color panels. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Space switches between the X and the plus. RULE: A shape instantly adopts the color of any panel it touches, allowing it to collect matching tokens. TRAP: Do not assume a shape’s initial color is permanent; it changes immediately upon contact with a new panel.

GOAL: Align the shapes on all four panels to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a panel to rotate its outer blocks while keeping the center fixed. RULE: The central glyph dictates the rotation direction for that specific panel. TRAP: Assuming all panels rotate simultaneously or independently without checking the central indicator.

GOAL: Match the highlighted 3x3 panel to its small preview image. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to change their color. RULE: The preview shows the required final state; make the panel identical to it. TRAP: Assuming the preview updates dynamically; it remains static as you edit the panel.

GOAL: Move both yellow blocks to the two marked slots on the outer ring. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the top ring, middle row, or bottom row in the indicated direction. RULE: Rotate the outer ring to align blocks with the slots, using row shifts to adjust positions between ring levels. TRAP: Assuming all moves affect the whole board; remember that only the top ring rotates the outer perimeter, while middle and bottom moves are linear shifts.

GOAL: Guide two squares to adjacent positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both squares simultaneously; blocked squares stay put. RULE: Red cells are lethal; plan paths avoiding them for both squares. TRAP: Assuming blocked moves fail the level; they safely stay put, enabling complex maneuvers.

GOAL: Paint every empty square to match the hidden widget shapes. CONTROLS: Tap a square to reveal its true color; correct hits turn solid. RULE: Each widget’s white pattern projects onto the grid around its center. TRAP: Do not click the widget’s own center square; it is blocked and wastes a move.
